name: Check the dashboard Erase and Battery tiles while armed
step: Check the dashboard Erase and Battery tiles while armed
rationale:
Ported from rotorflight-lua-ethos-suite PR #2541 (issue #2505):
two dashboard toolbar items write to the flight controller, blackbox erase and
battery profile, and neither their enable check nor their write path looked at the
arm state. A battery picker open at arming, or an erase confirmation answered after
arming, still wrote.

No build and no package step reaches this -- it is a touch path through a running
widget. The harness drives the real widgets/dashboard.lua through the descriptor the
radio calls, and feeds the arm state through session.update the way the session does.
While armed the Erase and Battery tiles are disabled, arming closes an open battery
picker, and a confirmed erase answered after arming publishes no msp.request.
Disarmed, the same paths publish their write again. The checks that depend on the
toolbar being reachable assert that it is reachable first, so a run that cannot
reach the tiles fails instead of passing vacuously. Run against unpatched
wingflight-lua-ethos-suite master, 11 of 19 checks fail.
